Divineguma Act, No. 1 of 2013
The  powers  of  the  divineguma  community  based

column1: organizations,  subject  to  the  direction  and  supervision  of

column2: to  organize  divineguma  beneficiaries  into  small
groups;
to  give  recognition  to  such  small  groups  within
the community based organizations;
to  implement  a  social  security  programme  for
divineguma  beneficiaries;
to  provide  necessary  facilities  for  divineguma
beneficiaries  in  order  to  secure  loans  from
divineguma  community  based  banks,  established
under section 25 of this Act;
to  supervise  and  regulate  loans  obtained  by
divineguma beneficiaries for livelihood activities;
to  provide  resources  and  facilities  for  such
progarmmes  as  may  be  implemented  to  develop
the skills and knowledge of its members;
to collect and manage membership fees and savings
of divineguma beneficiaries;
to undertake and implement programmes which are
being  initiated    by  the  Department  and  other
recognized  institutions  for  the  well  being  of
divineguma  beneficiaries;
to receive such assistance such as grants and loans,
as  may  be  provided  by  the  government,  non-
governmental  and  private  institutions;
to undertake and execute such contracts which may

be  given 
to  divineguma  community  based
organizations  by  the  government  and  other
